classification: preregistered bounded Apple crop-writer instruction-and-operand trace after the opened preconvergence run isolated prepare_layer sites and falsified unchanged-byte and symbol-start-window assumptions; not an opened arithmetic law, unseen transfer, or product-parity claim

frozenQuestion.objective: Retain the exact Apple AArch64 instructions and live operands at every already-isolated prepare_layer crop-write stop so the public crop-construction arithmetic can be replayed bit for bit.
frozenQuestion.entryRule: Set one pending breakpoint by the exact capture_backdrop symbol. On its first hit, read exactly 16384 bytes and require SHA-256 14f25960556bec9e88ba8ade176ee7f1d39b84726226ade3eb1b0f1be00b70d2 before enabling the bounded candidate breakpoint at symbol+0x2b58.
frozenQuestion.candidateRule: Inspect at most 512 symbol+0x2b58 invocations and select the first nonzero exact x19/x20/x24/layerState pointer chain whose owner+0xe0 binary64 rectangle exactly equals layerState+0xb0 int32 while source+0x50 still differs. Retain raw bytes before arming.
frozenQuestion.watchpointRule: Arm exactly four eight-byte write watchpoints at source+0x50, owner+0xe0, owner+0x248, and layerState+0xb0. Retain at most six hardware callbacks per watchpoint and 24 total. Preserve callbacks whose first eight watched bytes remain identical, classify them separately, and require at least one changed QuartzCore event per field.
frozenQuestion.siteRule: Require changed prepare_layer events at source offsets 0x530c and 0x5310, owner rectangle offset 0x4e18, owner region offset 0x3ef0, and layer-state rectangle offset 0x55c4. These offsets were opened from run 30780736839 and are prospective capture targets, not yet arithmetic semantics.
frozenQuestion.codeRule: For every hardware stop, retain exactly 4096 bytes beginning stopPC-2048, require the stop PC at byte offset 2048, and hash the exact bytes. Do not substitute the first 4096 bytes of a large resolved symbol.
frozenQuestion.operandRule: For every event, retain raw SBData bytes for x0-x30, sp, pc, cpsr, v0-v31, fpsr, and fpcr; 2048 bytes from sp; fixed source/owner/layer/layerState object prefixes of 384/768/512/384 bytes; and best-effort 256-byte probes beginning 64 bytes before every unique x0-x28 value in the inclusive range 0x100000000 through 0x0000ffffffffffff. Retain every pointer-probe failure rather than dropping it.
frozenQuestion.integrityRule: Require exact register inventories, byte counts, raw-value agreement for scalar registers, memory hashes, pointer grouping, contiguous per-field hit indices, a containing code window per event, the prospective prepare_layer site inventory, a normally completed target and timeline, zero LLDB failures, and a finalized trace.
frozenQuestion.semanticSeal: The CI gate may establish only trace integrity and capture of the preregistered instructions and operands. Instruction semantics, stopped-PC versus prior-instruction causality, full crop arithmetic, public policy, unseen transfer, and product parity remain sealed until the artifact is opened after the run.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: Any changed capture_backdrop hash, missing preconvergence object chain, missing watchpoint or prepare_layer site, register API incompatibility, non-containing code window, incomplete operand memory, stopped process, missing timeline, debugger failure, or validator failure fails closed while preserving the artifact.
